property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always calls the callee with the ERC-721-like selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the recorder sees that specific selector and the decoded args); the mutant that encodes approve(address,uint256) will cause the recorder to observe a different selector/decoded args for some inputs, so the property (every observed call uses the transferFrom selector and decodes to the provided args) is violated by the mutant.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector to a different signature so the external call invokes a different function selector, potentially returning a different result while call succeeds.
